neighbours.label: Additive/comparative connectives that introduce an example or parallel: sentence-initial 'Also', 'Like', 'Similarly', and mid-sentence 'including', 'such as', 'type'
fire:
Our school offers many clubs.
Also, students can join the robotics team after classes on Tuesday.

The stories are richer than the ones from films.
Like movies, books open doors to new lands.

Prices rose sharply in the spring.
Similarly, rents climbed in nearly every large city we studied.
Nature has made certain species, such as little bugs, that survive almost anywhere on earth.
The store sells many fruits, including apples, pears and plums, all picked this week.

A new culture grew from the music.
Also, from the ashes came a focus on dance and poetry.
Several cities, including Boston and Denver, have started free bus programs for residents.
He wrote me a message of the type that arrives monthly, telling me to update my account.
quiet: Clubs at school are plentiful, and students can join the robotics team after classes on Tuesday.
Books open doors to new lands, richer than the ones from the films we watch.
In the spring prices rose sharply, and rents climbed in nearly every large city we studied.
Certain small species made by nature survive almost anywhere on earth.
Every fruit the store sells was picked this week by local farmers.
From the ashes of the music grew a new culture and a focus on dance.
Free bus programs have started in many cities for residents, and more will follow soon.
Each month he sends a message telling me to update my account.

notes: Label and sentences written by Claude Sonnet subagents (8 poles each) from the card text alone (prompt: haiku_labeler/prompt_l5.md); one retry on mechanical checks. Part of a 192-pole layer-5 sweep.
